reply_text:
I replied in #coastal-team's thread to Bettina. I did not set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest.

My world tools have no scheduler, so I can't commit to a standing post. I offered instead to compile the digest on request each Monday, from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, with finance figures kept out unless they're already posted in the channel.

Two things to check:
- I didn't check whether the Hermes cron tool (cronjob_manage) could run this. It may be able to schedule it, but a scheduled job wouldn't have the world tools to read the channels, so I haven't verified it would work. My reply says someone with scheduler access would need to set it up, which is more definitive than I can back up.
- I haven't read either channel or searched the brain, since the request was only to schedule the digest.
